preregistration.datasets: All1000 exposed queries on each frozenGloVe10k/100k archive; preserve both ef128/256 cells, no selective queries.
preregistration.candidate_family: ef256 only, fixed for both corpus sizes before the discovery look; stop after entry or completed expansion. ef128 is a frozen baseline comparator, not a candidate rescue.

floors.role: relaxed necessary gate for any nonperfect throughput row requiring>=.99; not a final competitive recall claim
separate perfect floor; every query must discover every gold neighbor

preregistration.row_mapping: Development surrogates for ANN GloVe100 high/perfect recall rows; corpus subsets and exact-ID metric differ from published full ANN pages. Current strongest comparator and actual final row recall are unresolved; passing.99 cannot certify a stronger required recall or any MATRIX row.
primitive_objectives: total adjacency-ID reads in completed expansions
total fresh base-layer row estimates, including entry/recovery seeds
preregistration.fixed_baseline: For each corpus size,floor,objective: minimum full-trace count among the two already-recorded ef128/256 cells whose full oracle-discovery mean recall reaches that floor. Retain which ef supplied each denominator. Compare oracle-retention discovery to oracle-retention discovery, and separately report actual serving-selected recall only as context.
preregistration.threshold: Reject candidate prefix family for that corpus/floor if3*minimum_oracle_reads>best_fixed_reads OR3*minimum_oracle_estimates>best_fixed_estimates. Integer comparisons, no rounding; equality passes necessary gate.
preregistration.classifier_gate: No classifier work unless both independent bounds pass for the preregistered ef256 family at.99 on both corpus sizes. Passing remains insufficient: require one joint allocation, actual final-row recall, retention/reranking and predictor costs, and unseen-query validation before policy acceptance.
preregistration.perfect_handling: Always retain independent1.0 results. Any query missing a true neighbor at full ef256 makes its1.0 prefix allocation infeasible. A.99 pass never promotes or changes a perfect row.
preregistration.infeasible_handling: If sum of maximum discovered gold hits is below required hits, output infeasible_within_frozen_trace and irreducible missing-hit count. Do not compute a finite speedup, lower the floor, widen ef, or call this a global limit on adaptive deeper search.
preregistration.tail_and_per_query: No extra per-query recall minimum beyond benchmark rules. Every chosen prefix has<=its original query work, so primitive-work p99 cannot exceed that full trace. This does not establish runtime p99. No tail/memory/build constraint is waived.
preregistration.frozen_relaxations: Free exact result retention/reranking, zero oracle-decision cost, no upper-layer gain credited, no row-score time conversion. Both baseline and prefixes use the same counted base-layer work boundary.
no_rescue: No classifier fit before oracle threshold
No conversion from unrelated Yi/Llama profile percentages
